overview_description.description: REY is a Web3 and DeFi platform focused on turning on-chain activity into reward-based incentives. The platform combines decentralized finance tools, trading, yield access, and gamified reward mechanics into a single ecosystem where users can earn rewards while interacting with crypto protocols.
